text_block_list.text: Morning. Stepping outside—it was raining.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This rain... doesn't look like it's going 
to let up.
choice_data_list:
Yeah... looks like the track will be heavy 
today.

Yeah... looks like we're in for a heavy 
track today.

text_block_list.text:
We make our way from the hotel to Hanshin 
Racecourse. 
Though we walk briskly to avoid close 
contact with others as much as possible... 
I can't help noticing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...There are barely any people around. 
Even though this place would normally be 
bustling with a crowd.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even the shops... 
have temporary closure signs posted here 
and there...
(Shwaaaaaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
... 
There really isn't anyone here...

It was an eerie sight. On this exact day 
last year, 
some fifty thousand spectators packed the 
grandstands—yet today, they stood empty.

—Even so, we can still race. 
That was what I had told myself. 
Yet... this reality before us felt 
entirely different.

The only thing waiting to greet today's 
victor—was pure silence.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—Temperature check is all clear. 
Thank you for your cooperation today...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... 
The staff members seem terribly busy 
too...
choice_data_list:
I heard they've cut staff numbers down to 
the bare minimum.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I see... 
Because of infection prevention 
measures...
(Shwaaaaaaah...)

The sound of rain echoes. As if driving 
home the sheer 
gravity of the situation unfolding around 
us... heavy and unrelenting—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. A LANE notification...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san, look! 
At this photo...!

On the smartphone she handed me was a 
photo of the folks back in her hometown, 
each watching the broadcast from their own 
living rooms. They were all wearing 
matching happi coats.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
They even made banners... "Hang In There, 
Tact!" 
"You Can Do It!" "Tact Cheering Squad"... 
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that name... it's a classmate from 
elementary school! 
Wow, and names from the folks in Erimo, 
too...
choice_data_list: Everyone back home is cheering for you.
The whole town is rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

Right now, the wind of her hometown must 
be blowing 
through her heart. That harsh yet gentle 
wind 
that raised her—
choice_data_list: ...Come to think of it, this rain...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes?
choice_data_list: Rain is just another part of nature.

Rain's just another part of nature, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. In the mountains of 
Erimo, 
accompanied by gale-force winds and dense 
fog... 
the rain was a terrifying adversary.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The paths after rainfall were terribly 
muddy, 
and every step required complete focus.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yet, those fierce elements of nature... 
are what made me strong.
choice_data_list:
Right. That's why... you'll be unstoppable 
today.

Right. That's why... you're so strong 
today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
With the strength my hometown gave me, 
I can deliver victory... to everyone back 
home!

In that instant, the weight of the falling 
rain transformed. 
It became the raw power of nature, egging 
her on.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san. 
I will win. I'll bring back victory!
choice_data_list: Let's deliver hope with that first crown!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: TV Spectator
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... If this were any other year, 
I'd be watching live at the track...

text_block_list.name: TV Spectator
text_block_list.text:
...No, come on. Even with everything going 
on, 
we still get to watch the race. 
—I'm gonna see it through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...A rainy Oka Sho... 
Just how many years has it been since the 
last one?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact, I really can't tell... 
whether fortune favors you or not.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, look at the TV! 
There really isn't anyone in the stands...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Normally you'd hear everyone cheering... 
............It's kinda creeping me out.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. This is rare. 
Seeing you watch so quietly."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny told me, too. 
—Simply wait for the moment that comes 
next."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Destiny has already begun. 
Go, Daring Tact—carve your path with those 
legs!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...The only sounds echoing across the 
paddock 
are footsteps... and the patter of rain.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Racing without any spectators... 
...It must be even harder on the girls out 
there.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Ah, Daring Tact—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
What a powerful, resolute look in her 
eyes—

text_block_list.name: Competing Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
—I can't... my heartbeat is pounding so 
loudly...

text_block_list.name: Competing Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
I-It's way too quiet... The stage I 
dreamed of... 
the sight I longed for wasn't anything 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Um, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to take a deep breath with 
me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Relax your shoulders... open up your 
chest. 
Inhale deeply, as if drawing in the very 
scent of the turf...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
*in haaaaale*............—*ex 
haaaaale*............

text_block_list.name: Racing Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
*in haaaaale*............*ex 
haaaaale*............—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...What do you say? 
This is our usual, familiar place."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race is being streamed, too. 
Behind the cameras, 
so many people are watching over us."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"If you look beside you, your Trainer... 
is right there, watching over you."

text_block_list.name: Competing Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
"...! 
...That's right. You're right...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—Our race will reach them, without fail. 
Let's run with pride in our hearts...!"
